heading: Document header
text: Larkway Support Policy v5 Status: CURRENT Effective: 1 July 2026 Supersedes: Support Policy v4

heading: 1. Scope and source precedence
text: This policy sets the default severity levels and first-response targets for Larkway support. A signed customer agreement can override these defaults. When sources disagree, apply the signed customer agreement first, then this support policy and the current SOPs, then current product documentation. Past tickets and internal notes are background only and may record incorrect advice.

heading: 2. Severity definitions
text:
•  P1 - Critical: Customers cannot create any shipments (a full production outage), a confirmed security incident or suspected credential exposure, or any other event causing immediate serious business risk with no workaround. 
•  P2 - High: A major feature is unavailable or badly degraded for a customer, but core operations can continue or a workaround exists. 
•  P3 - Normal: A minor defect, a how-to question, a configuration request, or an issue with limited operational impact.

heading: 3. Default first-response targets
text: Plan P1 P2 P3 Enterprise 20 minutes, 24x7 90 minutes 1 business day Scale 1 business hour 3 business hours 2 business days Starter 3 business hours 1 business day 3 business days

heading: 4. Escalation
text: Escalate every P1 incident immediately. If a first-response target has already been breached, say so plainly and recommend escalation instead of hiding the uncertainty.

doc_title: Larkway Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v3
heading: 1. Order cancellation
text:
•  DRAFT: Can be cancelled at no charge. 
•  BOOKED, not yet PICKED_UP: Can be cancelled. No fee within 20 minutes of booking. After 20 minutes, charge INR 350 unless a customer agreement explicitly waives the cancellation fee. 
•  PICKED_UP: Do not cancel. Start the return-to-origin workflow if the customer wants the parcel back. 
•  DELIVERED: Cannot be cancelled.

doc_title: Larkway Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v3
heading: 2. Failed-pickup service credits
text: Under the default policy, a customer qualifies for a service credit when pickup happens more than 90 minutes after the end of the scheduled pickup window, the carrier is at fault, and the customer caused no part of the delay. The default credit is the lower of INR 600 or 15% of the shipment fee. A signed customer agreement may replace the default delay threshold, credit amount, or cap.

doc_title: Larkway Cancellation & Service Credit SOP v3
heading: 3. Approval and uncertainty
text:
•  Any single credit above INR 1,500 needs manager approval. 
•  Do not promise a credit while carrier fault, pickup timing, or customer fault is unknown. 
•  When records conflict, name the conflict and get verification before any state-changing action.

text: Larkway Product Operations Guide Status: CURRENT Updated: 15 September 2026

heading: 1. Plan capabilities
text:
•  Bulk Upload: Available on Scale and Enterprise. Supported file size is up to 8,000 rows per CSV. 
•  Starter: Bulk Upload is not included. 
•  Shipment status: BOOKED means the shipment exists but Larkway has not yet received pickup confirmation from the carrier. PICKED_UP means the carrier has confirmed pickup.

heading: KI-314 - Bulk Upload timeouts on large files
text: KI-314 - Bulk Upload timeouts on large files Opened: 9 September 2026 Status: Investigating Some Scale and Enterprise customers see intermittent timeouts on CSV uploads above roughly 2,500 rows, even though the supported limit is still 8,000 rows. Workaround: split the upload into files under 2,500 rows. Single shipment creation is not affected.

heading: KI-322 - TransVelo pickup confirmation lag
text: KI-322 - TransVelo pickup confirmation lag Opened: 14 September 2026 Status: Monitoring TransVelo pickup confirmation webhooks can arrive up to 35 minutes late. A parcel may already be collected while Larkway still shows BOOKED. Before telling a customer a pickup did not happen, check the carrier's status or wait out the known delay window.

text: Larkway - Halcyon Foods Enterprise Agreement Account: CUS-101 Customer: Halcyon Foods Term: 1 February 2026 to 31 January 2027 Status: ACTIVE

heading: 1. Support terms
text:
For Halcyon Foods, the following first-response targets replace Larkway's standard support-policy targets:
•  P1: 10 minutes, 24x7 
•  P2: 45 minutes 
•  P3: 6 business hours

heading: 2. Shipment cancellation
text: Halcyon Foods may cancel any BOOKED shipment before pickup with no cancellation fee, however long ago the shipment was booked. Once a shipment is PICKED_UP, the standard return-to-origin process applies.

heading: 3. Service credits
text: Total service credits in any calendar month are capped at INR 8,000. Unless this agreement says otherwise, the current Larkway service-credit SOP applies.

heading: 4. Account contact
text: Dedicated CSM: Kavya Nair.

text: Larkway - Brightmoor Textiles Service Agreement Account: CUS-102 Customer: Brightmoor Textiles Plan: Scale Term: 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027 Status: ACTIVE

heading: 1. Support terms
text:
•  P1: 1 business hour 
•  P2: 2 business hours 
•  P3: 2 business days 
•  No weekend or after-hours support coverage.

heading: 2. Cancellation terms
text: No special cancellation-fee waiver applies. Use the current Larkway Cancellation & Service Credit SOP.

heading: 3. Failed-pickup credits
text: If a pickup happens more than 3 hours after the end of the scheduled pickup window, the carrier is at fault, and the customer is not at fault, Brightmoor Textiles receives a fixed INR 2,000 service credit. This clause replaces the default failed-pickup credit amount and timing threshold in the SOP.
